description: This file defines the class 'BlockingSingleResultCallback', which implements 'BiConsumer' and 'ResultGetter' interfaces to provide a blocking mechanism for retrieving a single result asynchronously.

classes.name: BlockingSingleResultCallback
classes.description: A class that acts as a callback handler implementing BiConsumer to handle a result and a Throwable, and provides a blocking get() method to retrieve the result.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles the result and Throwable by delegating to an internal BlockingBiConsumer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the result, blocking if necessary until it is available.
